name: Ethiopia
title: የኢትዮጵያ ስነ-ጽሑፍ ቅርስ (Abyssinian Classical & Modern Heritage)
tagline: Ancient Ge'ez classical epics, profound Gojjam feudal tragedies, Red Terror memoirs, and revolutionary modern Amharic literature.

books.title: ፍቅር እስከ መቃብር (Fiqir Iske Meqabir)
books.author: ሀዲስ አለማየሁ (Haddis Alemayehu)
books.tagline: The supreme masterpiece of Ethiopian literature
books.description: The undisputed crown jewel of Ethiopian literature. A monumental tragic romance between Bezabih, a humble priest's son, and Seble-Wengel, the daughter of a proud feudal lord, shattering under the rigid caste hierarchies of 19th-century Gojjam.

books.title: ኦሮማይ (Oromay)
books.author: በአሉ ግርማ (Baalu Girma)
books.tagline: The courageous thriller that shook the Derg regime
books.description: Baalu Girma's explosive, banned masterpiece depicting the military bureaucracy and human cost of the 1982 Red Star Campaign in Eritrea. The novel exposed high-ranking officials with such unflinching realism that the author was abducted and executed shortly after publication.

books.title: ደራሲው (Derasiw / The Writer)
books.author: በአሉ ግርማ (Baalu Girma)
books.tagline: An existential journey through the Ethiopian writer's mind
books.description: A profound semi-autobiographical examination of artistic creation, moral dilemma, and psychological isolation as an Ethiopian author navigates urban Addis Ababa, social hypocrisy, and the search for authentic purpose.

books.title: አልወለድም (Alweledim / I Will Not Be Born)
books.author: አቤ ጉበኛ (Abe Gubegna)
books.tagline: A prophetic protest that defied imperial censorship
books.description: A fierce, visionary allegory in which an unborn child develops consciousness inside the womb and adamantly refuses delivery, interrogating the midwife on why anyone would choose to enter an Ethiopian world rife with feudal servitude, poverty, and deceit.

books.title: ከአድማስ ባሻገር (Keadmas Bashager)
books.author: በአሉ ግርማ (Baalu Girma)
books.tagline: The crossroads of tradition and modern Ethiopian ambition
books.description: Baalu Girma's celebrated debut novel depicting the philosophical clashes and emotional turmoils of educated Ethiopian university students torn between ancestral heritage and the alluring promises of Western modernity.

books.title: ክብረ ነገሥት (Kebra Nagast / The Glory of the Kings)
books.author: Traditional Ge'ez Canon (ሊቃውንት)
books.tagline: The foundational epic scripture of the Solomonic lineage
books.description: The sacred medieval Ge'ez epic of Ethiopia, chronicling the historic voyage of Queen Makeda to King Solomon of Jerusalem, the birth of Emperor Menelik I, and the divinely ordained transfer of the Ark of the Covenant to Axum Zion.

books.title: ዴርቶጋዳ (Dertogada)
books.author: ይስማዕከ ወርቁ (Yismaeke Worku)
books.tagline: The runaway modern Ethiopian technological thriller
books.description: The record-shattering modern thriller about brilliant Ethiopian computer scientists, underground engineering orders, and global geopolitical conspiracies seeking to control the secrets of Lake Tana and the Blue Nile.

books.title: ትኩሳት (Tiksat / Fever)
books.author: ስብሐት ገብረእግዚአብሔር (Sebhat)
books.tagline: The revolutionary bohemian voice of Addis Ababa
books.description: Sebhat's fearless, candid breakthrough in modern Amharic prose, breaking taboos with witty, raw observations of youthful vitality, romantic obsession, and coffeehouse intellectual fervor in downtown Piazza.

books.title: ጦቢያ (Tobiya / የመጀመሪያው ልብ-ወለድ)
books.author: አፈወርቅ ገብረ ኢየሱስ (Afawarq G.)
books.tagline: The historic dawn of the modern Amharic novel
books.description: Published in Rome in 1908, this is the revered first-ever novel written in the Amharic language, telling the tale of Wahid and the courageous, pure maiden Tobiya amidst religious conversion and chivalric adventure.

books.title: The Shadow King (የጥላው ንጉሥ)
books.author: ማዓዛ መንግሥቴ (Maaza Mengiste)
books.tagline: Shortlisted for the Booker Prize — the women of the Italian war
books.description: A magnificent Booker Prize-shortlisted epic illuminating the Ethiopian women fighters who took up arms alongside the Arbegnoch patriots against Mussolini's fascist invasion, centered on the brave peasant orphan Hirut.

books.title: Cutting for Stone (የድንጋይ ቀዶ-ህክምና)
books.author: አብርሃም ቫርጊስ (Abraham Verghese)
books.tagline: A monumental international bestselling family saga
books.description: A sweeping saga of twin brothers Marion and Shiva Stone, born conjoined to an Indian nun and British surgeon at Missing Hospital in Addis Ababa, bound by their profound love for medicine and the nation's political turbulence.

books.title: የአዕምሮ ጉዞ (YeAemro Guzo)
books.author: ዶ/ር ከበደ ሚካኤል (Kebede Michael)
books.tagline: The philosophical masterpiece of Ethiopia's greatest polymath
books.description: Dr. Kebede Michael's landmark philosophical work guiding Ethiopian youth through the history of world thought, human ingenuity, character development, and the intellectual virtues needed for national renewal.
